# Degenerate but Parseable Line

A zero-length LineString whose two vertices are identical. The geometry is parseable and loadable, but it is degenerate and invalid for many downstream geometric operations.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `degenerate_but_parseable_line` |
| Category | vector |
| Format | GeoJSON |
| Geometry type | LineString |
| CRS | `EPSG:4326` |
| Test tier | unit |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `geopandas` |
| Status | validated |

## What this case checks

Ensure loading succeeds for a degenerate but parseable line while making its zero-length invalidity explicit to validation logic.
